observations.styleDelivery: BEFORE uses inline var(--oh-status-*) colors. AFTER resolves the identical theme/host variables through text-status-error/success classes.

authenticity: Every UI crop comes from an actual control-openhands recording on the corresponding product source. Only cropping/scaling, recorded-frame holds, captions and original music were added. Title cards/captions label the evidence and do not purport to be Canvas UI.
limits: The film shows Neutral diff counts and an actual 404 toast, plus a Light+ actual connection-loss error icon. It does not claim a five-theme live audit or a contrast redesign.
Separate real screenshots also cover Light+ 404 toast and phone toast/error-icon rendering. The existing phone overview is hidden; no visible phone diff-count pass is claimed.

The baseline model remained running when the backend was deliberately stopped; no model response success is claimed. Zero ActionEvents were observed among 4 events. The after run encountered an unrelated SDK CacheableResult import failure; no SDK fix is included.
An existing Thinking pill overlaps part of the baseline phone banner text. The film uses the unobscured desktop icon/message region and excludes that pill. No broad mobile-layout pass is claimed.
After-head +0/-0 frames following a reload are excluded from actual +3/-1 diff proof.
Full source runs were stopped and all their owned ports verified closed. Credentials were read only by the preset setup through a private key file and are absent from published pixels and metadata.
